verdict_scope: Neither conditional route is ready for L5 promotion or a new real-data diagnostic on its present novelty/task premise. This does not evaluate a primary candidate and does not change accepted scoped L4.

independence.executed: In-memory elementary arithmetic and SHA256 ordering of one synthetic sample ID; no model, Torch, training, dataset, cache, remote, restoration, or secondary agent execution.

preserved_evidence.observed: Five-seed fixed-cohort Q-uniform Macro +0.305841 and selected-head label-blind context-permutation CE damage +0.202014, accepted conditionally under the recorded paired-t assumptions; sign-flip p=0.0625 remains.

must_fix: Choose a substantive scientific premise beyond the exact identities below. Neither arithmetic verification nor a newly named diagnostic is sufficient.

For route 1, justify why effect-realizable interventions answer a live task question and how their different constraint set can be compared fairly with the accepted fixed-weight replay. Generic off-family interventions do not invalidate that replay.

For route 2, specify an independently meaningful evidence-redundancy or nuisance process. A hidden-feature duplication identity alone does not predict natural-text robustness or explain the original Macro gain.

Audit the appropriate near-neighbor literature before novelty claims. The packet supports bounded collision analysis only, not an exhaustive novelty finding. Any utility extension needs independent evidence; outcome-guided reuse is descriptive.

hypotheses.title: Does accepted permutation alignment extend to changes realizable by the measurement scorer?
hypotheses.material_difference: Studies the image of the actual Born scorer and the support of its accepted intervention, rather than a Rayleigh certificate, CE curvature decomposition, or a new classifier architecture.
hypotheses.proposed_new_contribution: A theory-empirical account distinguishing dependence on arbitrary tokenwise weight reassignment from dependence under changes implementable by a shared relation measurement. A useful result would identify a task-relevant discrepancy, predict it out of sample, and show why it matters to Q-RMEA's ordinary alignment claim. No such result is currently observed.
known_tools_not_contribution: The elementary nullspace identity derived below
equations: rho_t=|psi_t><psi_t|, E=|phi><phi|, epsilon=1e-6, B_t=rho_t+epsilon I, alpha_t=Tr(E B_t)/Tr(E sum_s B_s).

An optimistic relaxation allowing any mixed effect is C(rho)={beta: exists Q>=0 with Tr(Q B_t)=beta_t for every valid t}. The equations imply sum beta=1 and E=Q/Tr(Q); the actual rank-one circuit family is a subset. This is a normalization-aware feasibility formulation, not a new POVM or PGM.

If sum_t c_t B_t=0, every feasible beta obeys c^T beta=0. More generally sum_t c_t B_t>=0 implies c^T beta>=0. A violation rules out even a mixed effect; satisfying the relaxed equations does not establish rank-one/circuit reachability.
When ||c||_infinity=1 and c^T beta=0 for all feasible beta, inf_{beta in C}||alpha_pi-beta||_1 >= |c^T alpha_pi|.
Per-example feasibility is only necessary for one global E_r explaining a whole cohort. It must not be reported as sufficient for the shared-effect model.

source_exact_counterexample.scope: Synthetic finite-input fixture of the executed Q-RMEA source, not Re-TACRED evidence.
source_exact_counterexample.construction: All first-layer circuit angles and all RZ angles are zero. Only the second-layer wire-0 RY angle theta_t varies. The final CNOT ring maps |100> to |011>, hence psi_t=cos(theta_t/2)|000>+sin(theta_t/2)|011>. Set h[t,0]=atanh(theta_t/pi), h[t,1]=u_t and remaining features zero. prepare has only output coordinate 6 reading h[...,0], with zero bias, so pi*tanh exactly yields the finite angles below. All effect parameters are zero, giving phi=|000>. Set value coordinate 0 to h[...,1], true-class decoder coordinate 0 to 1, all other decoders zero, true bias log(39), other biases zero. Role features mark token 4 as subject and token 5 as object; prepare ignores roles. All masks are true.
source_exact_counterexample.matrix_identity: rho_0+rho_1=rho_2+rho_3, and sum c=0 cancels the epsilon floor.
source_exact_counterexample.verification: Elementary circuit reduction, in-memory floating-point arithmetic, and the source-identical SHA256 sorting rule. No RMEAHead execution was performed. Entity weights, values, bias, masks, and total context mass are fixed by the swap. Reversing all listed true-class utilities reverses CE damage while preserving the same support violation.
source_exact_counterexample.conclusion: Positive damage under the exact implemented replay can coexist with a shuffled distribution impossible for any effect on the same states. This does not invalidate the accepted fixed-weight functional-dependence endpoint, nor show that real-data permutations are infeasible.

assumptions: Prepared states and the value head are held fixed, as in accepted replay.
A claim about changing the measurement must respect rank one, the depth-two circuit, and a globally shared effect. The PSD relaxation may reject but cannot certify all these requirements.

No assumption is made that feasible measurement changes preserve a relation's meaning, preserve entity weights, or can match an arbitrary permutation's perturbation size. Those are missing comparison premises.

nearest_work_collisions.collision: Basic density features, squared-overlap kernels and their linear structure are established.

Counterfactual attention, nonunique explanations, trained uniform controls and intervention interpretation are established. Off-family intervention observations alone are unlikely to be a substantive novelty.
This is not a newly discovered measurement normalization or PGM. The feasibility question is different, but general quantum probability realization/SDP work would require a separate audit.

hypotheses.link_to_accepted_endpoint: The exact alpha_pi and frozen values in the accepted CE endpoint are the objects tested for measurement feasibility. The theory clarifies which extrapolation the endpoint can support; it does not explain the trained Q-uniform Macro gain by itself.
hypotheses.minimal_kill_test: The six-token fixture already kills any implication positive accepted-style CE damage => an attainable changed relation measurement. To kill the proposed real-data question cheaply, find that archived actual permutations have negligible distance to the relaxed set, or that no meaningful matched attainable comparison exists. A large infeasibility count alone is not a success gate.
hypotheses.smallest_meaningful_next_validation: Before any model restoration, write and audit the exact intended scientific comparison and its invariants. If justified and suitable existing detached arrays later become available under their own evidence contract, use at most 16 preselected examples to test a necessary feasibility witness and demonstrate one genuinely circuit-realizable, globally shared intervention with documented confounds. This is descriptive screening, not new utility confirmation. Stop if the comparison reduces to generic off-family fragility or only certifies the synthetic fixture.
hypotheses.new_evidence_or_model_required: No changed architecture is needed to ask the question. Real prepared-state traces are required for any cohort statement. An independent prospectively specified intervention/cohort is needed for stronger utility inference. If preserving the original entity/context constraints leaves no nontrivial scorer intervention, the task premise fails rather than authorizing a new mechanism.
hypotheses.readiness: BLOCK: a source-exact counterexample is established; a nontrivial task contribution and novelty are not.

hypotheses.title: Can the learned gates predict an independently meaningful context-redundancy robustness budget?
hypotheses.material_difference: Studies exact repeated-token response of normalized bounded pooling and a prospective robustness prediction. It does not introduce an ordered, joint, complement, outcome-contrast, or spectrum head.
hypotheses.proposed_new_contribution: A validated theory linking learned relation-specific gates, stable class margins, and robustness to an independently defined evidence-redundancy process. The contribution would be the predictive mechanism and evidence, not the rational-function identity. No natural-text or held-out robustness result is observed.
known_tools_not_contribution: Rational-function algebra and margin root finding
equations: For one original valid context token j, let q_rj=p_rj+epsilon, Z_r=sum_t q_rt, mu_r=sum_t q_rt u_rt/Z_r, a_r=b_r+mu_r and l_r=b_r+u_rj. Duplicate the complete frozen (h_j,roles_j) m additional times and retain all other features. Source-local scoring makes every copy have the same q and u.
z_r(m)=(Z_r a_r+m q_rj l_r)/(Z_r+m q_rj)=a_r+[m q_rj/(Z_r+m q_rj)](l_r-a_r).

For a true class y and rival k, sign(z_y(m)-z_k(m)) is sign(C0+C1 m+C2 m^2), where C0=Z_y Z_k(a_y-a_k), C1=Z_y q_kj(a_y-l_k)+q_yj Z_k(l_y-a_k), C2=q_yj q_kj(l_y-l_k). All denominators are positive. The first integer margin failure must account for possible two-root/nonmonotone behavior.
d[z_y-z_k]/dm at 0 = (q_yj/Z_y)(l_y-a_y)-(q_kj/Z_k)(l_k-a_k). A low true-class score alone is insufficient: the rival's gate and utility also matter.

Because epsilon<=q_rj<=1+epsilon, no token is perfectly rejected. Half of a class logit's limiting shift occurs at m=Z_r/q_rj <= T(1+epsilon)/epsilon. As m grows, z_r(m) tends to b_r+u_rj. If that limiting class ranking is wrong, finite repetition eventually breaks the original correct decision.

These equations hold for every source mode with per-token scores independent of sequence length, after choosing its q. Uniform has q=1, Z=T. For relation_softmax, q=exp(score) and the same identity holds. The identity therefore cannot establish a specifically quantum contribution.

arithmetic_check.scope: Scalar pooling algebra check only; no claim that these aggregate numbers were jointly synthesized by the actual circuit or observed on Re-TACRED.
arithmetic_check.conclusion: Exactly eight additional copies first reverse this pair's ranking. Merely deriving this threshold is not a new theory contribution.

assumptions: Only the post-encoder feature sequence is duplicated. Re-encoding duplicated raw text generally changes every contextual feature, so the formula does not certify natural-text robustness.
The complete role features are copied along with h. This is a defined hidden-feature intervention, not a claim about ordinary word-position recomputation.

The duplicated token is not automatically nuisance: contextual h may carry useful entity/relation information even for a function word. An independently meaningful perturbation process and label stability must be supplied.

Original uniform and Q heads have different learned values and parameter counts. A same-value uniformized replay answers a different question from the historical trained-head utility comparison. Neither may silently substitute for the other.

nearest_work_collisions.collision: Quantum attention with normalized classical aggregation, including direct squared-overlap attention, is established; normalization algebra cannot be the novelty.
Frozen-representation attention counterfactuals, functional sensitivity and uniform comparisons are established.
The bounded Born/kernel score is known. A dedicated audit of normalized kernel pooling and attention robustness is missing.

hypotheses.link_to_accepted_endpoint: Original CE permutation damage shows local weight-value dependence but does not imply resistance to repeated low-quality context. This route would test whether the same learned allocation that supports that dependence yields a predictable task-level robustness property. The original Macro and CE aggregates alone do not identify the q/Z and rival-utility quantities needed.
hypotheses.minimal_kill_test: Reject a universal robustness claim immediately: epsilon forces every repeated token eventually to dominate each class logit, and the rival-specific formula can reverse an initially correct margin. Kill the research premise if the only prediction is exact replay arithmetic, if the perturbations have no independent label-preserving meaning, or if a generic existing pooling theory fully accounts for the claimed contribution.
hypotheses.smallest_meaningful_next_validation: First specify the external perturbation process and the intended useful prediction without seeing new outcomes. Only then, with appropriately available detached arrays, predict integer thresholds for a tiny preselected sample and check exact replay. Such a check validates implementation only. A substantive result additionally needs predeclared predictions on independent perturbations/examples and fair comparisons to existing heads; it must not start a new full experiment merely because the identity passes.
hypotheses.new_evidence_or_model_required: No new architecture is required for the hidden-feature identity. Real q,u traces and independent evidence are needed for a useful robustness statement. A claim about raw-text changes requires controlling or bounding the contextual encoder's change, a premise absent from this packet. Failure does not reopen a stopped family.
hypotheses.readiness: BLOCK: the algebra is exact and useful as a design check, but the independent task process and distinctive contribution are absent.

overall_conclusion: The strongest independent result is a source-compatible, actual-hash CE counterexample locating a limitation of measurement-level interpretation. It preserves the accepted replay conclusion. Neither route presently supplies the missing substantive novelty plus independently discriminating task evidence needed for L5. Do not spend restoration/training resources on these equations alone.
verification_limits: Only the synthetic hash ordering and elementary numeric equations were executed. No full model/source fixture execution, literature exhaustiveness, actual-data geometry, robustness, or L5 certification is claimed.
